// diagnostic

E3206

Module path `{path}` uses the reserved segment `__bindgen__`.

What

Module path `{path}` uses the reserved segment `__bindgen__`.

Why

Autogen lives in `c.{lib}.__bindgen__`; users declare overlays as `#Import c.{lib}: module` only.

Fix

Drop `__bindgen__` from your module path, or use `#Import c.{lib}: module { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3206: tests/ui/cffi_e3206_reserved_segment.stderr.

Error [jet.ReservedBindgenSegment]: Module path `c.demo.__bindgen__` uses the reserved segment `__bindgen__`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_e3206_reserved_segment.jet:1:9
    |
  1 | #Import c.demo.__bindgen__: module {
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Generated bindings live under `c.<lib>.__bindgen__`; user overlays use `#Import c.<lib>: module`
 Fix: Remove `.__bindgen__` and declare the overlay as `#Import c.<lib>: module`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E3206

Error [jet.InvalidStatement]: Expected `=` before the C symbol, found `{`
  --> tests/ui/cffi_e3206_reserved_segment.jet:2:16
    |
  2 |     ping: fn() { }
    |                ^
 Why: The parser needs the expected token to keep the surrounding syntax unambiguous
 Fix: Write the expected token here
